What I’m About

I’m driven to make technology meaningfully better, whether in a controlled homelab or by helping others resolve complex, real-world challenges.

I’m Domi. A lifelong technologist, I’ve turned early curiosity into a disciplined practice of designing systems that solve consequential, real-world problems.

My homelab operates as a focused R&D environment: I stress-test, break, and harden ideas, then productionize what proves robust.

Beyond configuration and automation work, I codify and share what I learn so others can navigate complexity faster. That moment when everything clicks and just works is the target.
